## Requirements: MCP Documents detail prioritizes Tool contract ### User decision (2026-11-16) The MCP detail viewer currently opens with a large upstream protocol version/changelog panel; the actual Tool name and description are pushed below. Inputs are only a collapsible raw JSON Schema, and outputs do not appear at all. The user's desired priority is **Tool name → description → detailed input fields / meanings → detailed output fields / meanings**. Protocol versions are supplementary context, not the hero. ### Verified source constraint - `pages/mcp-documents.js` renders the upstream panel before Tool identity and only exposes inputSchema in `
`. - `crates/nession-mcp/src/tool.rs` constructs the runtime `tools/list` descriptor using `Tool::new(name, description, input_schema)`; `crates/nession-mcp/src/bin/nession-mcp-schema.rs` exports that registry. **None of the registered 11 Nession Tools currently supplies an outputSchema**. JSON reply Values from backends and test fixtures are **not** an attested return contract. The official MCP protocol permits optional `outputSchema`, but its absence cannot be silently interpreted as an empty/known output. - This Issue owns the Pages reader presentation and truthful output provenance. A separate Rust Tool/outputSchema contract implementation is required before all output field rows can honestly be populated; that is not a Pages styling change. ### Required design 1. Keep the two-pane bounded Pages Documents workspace delivered in #3724. Within a selected Tool's detail pane, show its **exact registered name** and **registered description** first. Show source link and compact protocol version tags as secondary metadata. 2. Render `inputSchema` into a readable, accessible, bounded list/table of fields including **full path, type, required/optional status, and the exact `description` when supplied**. Follow only local JSON Schema `$defs`/pointer refs; handle nested objects, arrays, unions/null, enum and safe recursion/budget guards without inventing missing meanings. Keep raw input JSON Schema under progressive disclosure. 3. Provide an equally prominent **Output fields** section. When an actual canonical optional Tool `outputSchema` is present and validated, show its fields/paths/types/descriptions using the same renderer with optional raw schema. When absent, explicitly state that **no structured output schema is advertised**; do not guess response field names/types from runtime examples. 4. Move the independently pinned official stable release, highlights and previous versions into a compact *collapsed by default* section after the Tool contract. Keep official links and provenance; no source-to-MCP runtime calls, no credentialed/public-data changes. 5. Preserve deep links/search, invalid/unavailable states, mobile/desktop independent pane scrolling, XSS safety, and the canonical Pages visual language. ### SC → verification scenario - SC-01/02: **SCN-02 Chromium browser UI**; exact-head Pages/Playwright `pages-mcp` fixtures test priority, input nested field descriptions, output available/absent presentation, collapsed upstream and mobile behavior. - SC-03: **SCN-01 deterministic contract**; source/unit tests assert schema flattening limits, local-only refs, no invented descriptions, output truthful-unavailable behavior, and current publisher semantics unmodified. ### Success Criteria - [x] SC-01: MCP details foreground registered Tool name/description and display compact version provenance only as secondary collapsed context; the Tool contract remains first on desktop and mobile, with existing list navigation and deep links intact. - [x] SC-02: A source-backed JSON Schema input field list displays correct nested field paths, types, required markers and exact descriptions; a validated Tool outputSchema, if supplied, renders corresponding output fields, while absent outputSchema clearly shows `not declared`, never fictional fields. - [x] SC-03: Input/output schema presentation rejects or bounds unsafe/malformed refs, recursion and field counts, preserves escaped text and raw-schema inspection; previous Pages MCP publication contract and unrelated Protocol viewer are unchanged. ## Acceptance Plan ```yaml acceptance: SC-01: when: pr method: agent SC-02: when: pr method: agent SC-03: when: pr method: agent ``` ## Acceptance Report | Criterion | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | SC-01 | Pass | run 43859903243; ref f78327e0ebecda4bdcc5df61deaea173c77c945c; source agent-qwen; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:244-253 — renderMcpDocuments appends eyebrow 'REGISTERED MCP TOOL', h2=selected.name, p=selected.description, then inline 'Nession MCP · ' meta + pinned source link, then renderFields(inputSchema)/renderFields(outputSchema); file: pages/mcp-documents.js:255-275 — upstream provenance rendered as separate
with no `open` attribute, summary 'Protocol & provenance · MCP ' → collapsed by default; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:173-182 mcpToolRoute parses #/documents/mcp?tool= with NAME regex /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,127}$/; lines 221-227 list entries are with aria-current on selection; line 238 back link, line 186 breadcrumb; file: pages/styles.css:303-313 @media(max-width:900px) collapses to single-pane with .documents-browser-pane hidden when reading; test: e2e/tests/browser/pages-mcp.spec.ts:106-116 asserts heads[0]=='nession_server_list_agents' and .documents-mcp-spec not[open]; lines 55-78 mobile viewport 390x844 deep-link + back + scrollWidth<=innerWidth+2; summary: Tool name/description rendered first, compact inline provenance secondary, upstream panel in collapsed
; list nav, deep links, breadcrumbs, mobile pane behavior all preserved and E2E-verified. | | SC-02 | Pass | run 43859903243; ref f78327e0ebecda4bdcc5df61deaea173c77c945c; source agent-qwen; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:95-131 mcpSchemaFields walks properties producing {path, type, required, description, values}; nested via prefix+'.'+name, arrays via path+'[]', required from item.required Set, descriptions sliced to 2500 chars, enum bounded ≤16; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:76-94 fieldType handles explicit type, anyOf/oneOf (slice 0..20, joined ' \| '), enum→'enum', object→'object'; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:41-43 validMcpSnapshot rejects null/string/array/oversized (>50000 chars) outputSchema — catalog rejected rather than silently inventing; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:132-172 renderFields(falsy schema) appends

with exact wording 'No structured output schema is declared by this Nession Tool. Output field names, types and meanings cannot yet be verified from the Tool registry.'; test: e2e/tests/browser/pages-mcp.spec.ts:80-120 asserts nested paths ['scope','filters','filters.agent_id','agents','agents[].id','cursor'] and exact descriptions; :122-133 asserts .documents-mcp-missing contains 'No structured output schema is declared'; test: pages/tests/mcp-documents.test.mjs:57-68 unit tests reject outputSchema null/'guess'/oversized and preserve exact description on valid schema; summary: Input schema renders correct nested paths/types/required/descriptions; outputSchema rendered when present, explicit 'not declared' message when absent, catalog rejected on malformed outputSchema — no invented fields. | | SC-03 | Pass | run 43859903243; ref f78327e0ebecda4bdcc5df61deaea173c77c945c; source agent-qwen; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:50-59 localSchemaRef only resolves ^#\/(?:\$defs\|definitions)\/ — remote refs and out-of-scope fragments → null → 'unresolved reference'; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:60-75 deref uses trail Set for cycle detection + MAX_DEPTH=9 hard cap; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:99 walk stops at depth>MAX_DEPTH or fields.length>=MAX_FIELDS(160); path.length>240 and name.length>128 guards; description.slice(0,2500); file: pages/mcp-documents.js:13 el() uses textContent → descriptions escaped, no innerHTML; file: pages/mcp-documents.js:165-170 raw JSON Schema in

collapsed by default; test: pages/tests/mcp-documents.test.mjs:43-56 asserts remote/missing/cyclic refs all → 'unresolved reference', 250-field schema capped to 160, null → []; test: e2e/tests/browser/pages-mcp.spec.ts:11-12 clicks 'Input JSON Schema' and asserts .documents-raw code contains '"type": "object"'; file: pages/scripts/mcp-export-gate.mjs, mcp-semantic.mjs, mcp-reconcile.mjs, publication-receipt.mjs, publish-prototypes.mjs — publication pipeline untouched (separate scripts); file: pages/documents.js — Protocol catalog renderer at #/documents/protocol, separate classes (.documents-layout, .documents-versions, .documents-contract-section, .documents-field-table, .documents-since) unrelated to .documents-mcp-* classes; summary: Remote/malformed refs rejected, cycles bounded, field counts and path/name lengths capped, descriptions truncated, all text via textContent (XSS-safe), raw schema preserved under collapsed disclosure; MCP publication scripts and Protocol viewer are separate files with separate class namespaces and were not modified. | ## E2E Verification ### New - none: expand existing `pages-mcp` Chromium fixture; no duplicate catalog ID ### Regression - pages-mcp ## E2E Report | ID | Type | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---|---| | pages-mcp | Regression | Pass | run 43859910725/1, SHA f78327e0ebecda4bdcc5df61deaea173c77c945c, contract 7f9e9f5de009a36bfbda3a5e93421c27d797dffc648028042ab8d596c1502098, plan 33d8cb7e7bc5363d6c4a554a67b6b842081988e90ecd76f7ae204a1336094ed0, tests 5/5 (https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/43859910725) | ## Product alignment - [x] VISION: coherent technical reference experience - [x] PRINCIPLE: progressive disclosure, essential work first - [x] Pages independent visual ownership, no Nession Web runtime dependencies --- **Status:** Approved — user requested this MCP detail hierarchy correction.
